comments.text: Tile 0 of tile set 8, its only blank tile: 629 squares of the layers, the black between the buildings of map 18 (413), gaps on maps 20 (61) and 22 (149) and the black left side of map 23's sunken square (6); 474 of them class 11. It is the off-map tile of maps 17, 18, 19, 20 and 22. Set 8 serves seven maps of side 4: 16 (its gate's sign names Base Cochise), 17, 18 ('Entering the Environmental Testing facility.'), 19 ('Entering a one way force field.'), 20, 22 and 23.

Tiles 1-6, the figures every set shares (1 grey robot-like humanoid, 2 red and orange one-eyed hulk, 3 yellow and green runner, 4 man in a cyan shirt, 5 tied sack, 6 brown horned creature). Map 20's layer has 2 at (4, 29), a class-4 square that shows 1 instead. Computed from the records, encounter squares would show 1 (map 16: 16, 18: 5, 19: 1, 20: 4, 23: 4), 2 (map 23: 2) or 6 (map 23: 1); tile 5 shows on the loot-bag squares (16, 13) of map 16 and (25, 1) of map 19.

Tile 7, the green-shirted party figure, drawn on the party's square by game $AF1D-$AF25. No layer of set 8 holds it; map 22's class-4 square (2, 13) shows it over the chair 36. draw_tile's self-modified LDA operand ($2367) points here because tile 7 was drawn last.

Tile 8, the radiation sign that draw_square shows from 18:00 to 05:59 ($0B80-$0B8A) on class-9 squares: 60 on map 19 (x 1-11, y 13-18, all over the brown stripes 41) and 44 on map 20 (x 1-13, y 1-13, over the lattice 51 or the blank 0); by day they show their layer tile.

Tile 9 of set 8, a purple peak over light blue and blue bars as in sets 1-5 and 7, the picture game $AD13-$AD49 draws for each other party of the player's on the same map; none of set 8's layers holds it.

Tiles 10-14 of set 8: 10, 11 and 14 grey and white courses, the top right corner (3 squares), right side (6) and top (6) of a square drawn sunken in perspective at x 13-18, y 13-18 of map 23; 12 a black hole ringed by red and white bricks (8 class-10 squares of map 22, four in the middle of rings of the speckles 66, four beside its walls); 13 a white frame around two blue and light blue panels (map 22 at (39, 33)).

Tiles 15-21 of set 8, the orange blocks of sets 2, 4, 5 and 7: most of them furnish map 22's room at x 55-62, y 12-24 (15: 5, 16: 5, 17: 4, 18: 5, 19-21 one each); 16-18 also make two blocks two squares tall at map 19's (6, 13-14) and (6, 17-18), 16 stands at map 22's (3, 13) and 19 at map 18's (30, 11).

Tiles 22 and 23 of set 8, white rings linked by blue bars between red edges, two versions of the wall pattern: 22 on maps 16, 18 and 20 (640 squares, 598 class 11; map 20's class-4 square (16, 9) shows it) and 23 on maps 17, 19 and 22 (1163, all class 11 but four).

Tiles 24-26 of set 8: 24 and 25 white stripes on dark grey, falling and rising, the chevron floor inside map 16's walls (25 and 30 squares, x 12-21, y 5-14); 26 a white ring around blue and red bands (map 16 at (17, 10), (16, 11), (17, 12); map 17's class-4 squares (1, 17) and (30, 17), which show the stripes 41).

Tiles 27-29 of set 8, on map 20: 27 a white ring round a grey hub, a knob on top, like a wheel (16, 9), a class-4 square that shows the wall 22; 28 a white head with two black eyes on a ribbed white stand (6 squares at x 22-27, y 1-9); 29 red, white and blue scraps (6 at x 20-24, y 4-7); all class 2 but 27.

Tiles 30-35 of set 8: 30 grey right of a diagonal, the bottom right corner of map 23's sunken square (3 squares); 31 a blue panel flecked purple and white between white bars (11 class-10 squares: map 19 at (16, 1), map 22: 9, map 23 at (11, 15)); 32 grey and white diagonals crossing on black (map 23: 16, at x 13-16, y 5-10 and (16, 27-30)); 34 a white, blue and grey rounded shape on black (map 19: 22, class 2); 33 and 35 light blue and white shapes with spread limbs: 35 unused by the maps; 33 in no layer, but the tile of map 16's class-4 record 3 ($3C72), which (18, 12) becomes once message square 1 ($3A62), put there by remote-change record 2 ($3D9A), has shown message 27, the helicopter crashing onto the concrete dome.

Tiles 36-38 of set 8: 36 a brown chair with its back at the left (map 22's class-4 square (2, 13), which shows the party figure 7); 37 a yellow zigzag in a red bracket and 38 a white pole flying a light blue pennant, two columns of each on purple floor in map 18's room at x 18-23, y 17-20 (8 squares each, class 2).

Tiles 39-41 of set 8: 39 brown stripes crossed by a white zigzag (the four class-4 squares at x 14-17, y 16-18 of map 17, which show 41); 40 set 2's door 32 in light blue and blue (map 22: 3, class 8; its class-4 squares (1-3, 19) show it over the floor 63); 41 brown stripes on black (204 squares: the cross-shaped hall of map 17 (129), map 19's class-9 squares (60), map 20 at x 14-17, y 14-17 (15)).

Tiles 42-44 of set 8, in no layer: 42 set 1's counter figure 10 with the same colours, a blonde figure in purple behind a brown counter, unused by the maps; 43 red and white bricks around a black hole and 44 around a white ring, map 18's land mines: a group the party spots shows as 44 (class-4 record 2, $3BD3), and a mine that goes off (land_mine_blast, $3C09) leaves a crater, 43 (class-4 record 1, $3BD0, 'You stumble on a small crater.').

Tiles 45-50 of set 8: 45 a brown table with yellow, purple, blue and green things on it (map 20's four corners, (1, 1), (30, 1), (1, 30), (30, 30)); 46 white rungs between black rails (9 squares, 8 class 10, the exits: maps 16, 17, 18, 19, 20; map 18's class-4 square (2, 31) shows 57 over one); 47 red with a white right edge (map 18 at (16, 1-4)) and 49 with a white left edge (map 18 at (30, 3)); 48 rows of green dots, unused; 50 black over a dark grey line, set 4's 65, the bottom of map 23's sunken square (6).
Tile 51 of set 8 (set 5's 51 too), purple diagonal lines crossing on black: the floor of maps 18 (107 squares), 19 (498), 20 (542) and 22 (1432), 2579 in all, 37 of them map 20's class-9 squares.

Tiles 52-56 of set 8: 52 black with a dark grey diagonal, set 4's 66, the bottom left corner of map 23's sunken square (3) and 56 grey and white courses above a black diagonal, its top left corner (3); 53 white and light blue knots between blue lines, two columns in map 18's room at x 26-27, y 17-20 (8, class 2); 54 grey and white rubble, in no layer but the tile of map 23's class-4 record 1 ($3D45, 'Broken pieces of silicon crackle beneath your feet.'), which a silicon wall at (16, 5) or (13-16, 10) becomes when it is shattered (check record 19, $3C4B); 55 a black arch in white and grey, unused by the maps.

Tiles 57-62 of set 8: 57 a blue panel notched light blue between white bars, set into the walls of maps 16, 18, 19, 20 and 22 (44 squares, 33 class 2, 8 class 10); over purple specks, 58 brown, white and light blue shapes (45 squares on all maps but 16 and 23; 21 class 11, 6 class 8) and 59 light blue, white and purple ones (map 20: 4); 60 light blue rings over white bars (map 20: 25); 61 white bars around a brown and blue column (map 18: 4, 20: 5); 62 a light blue, blue and white band turning a corner (map 17: 2).

Tiles 63-68 of set 8, red dashes on black of several densities: the open ground of maps 16, 18 and 22 (63: 958 squares, also map 16's off-map tile; 64: 497; 65: 914; 67: 49 and 68: 52, both map 16 only); 66 red, white and blue speckles (101: map 16: 21, map 22: 80, where they ring the holes 12).

Tiles 69-71 of set 8: 69 a red and white frame edged blue (map 22 at (50, 29), (61, 29), (50, 39)); 70 and 71 corners of the light blue, grey and white band (map 17 at (17, 15); (14, 9) and (18, 20)).

Tiles 72-74 of set 8: 72 sparse red, white and blue speckles (118 squares: map 16: 28, map 22: 90); 73 blue with red specks, the band across the north of map 17 (108 squares, x 1-30, y 1-6, class 11); 74 a blue panel cut by black slots with red marks, in that band (map 17: 19).

Tiles 75-79 of set 8: 75 black and white checks, set 4's 38 (map 23: 264 squares, its off-map tile); 76 four short bars, blue, orange, green and red, each with a white stripe and a black square (map 23: 7, six class 8); 77 grey bricks, unused by the maps; 78 and 79 dark grey with black chevrons pointing right and down (78: map 19: 16; 79: map 19: 10 and map 17 at (31, 7)), in map 19's middle room at x 14-24, y 13-21.

Tiles 80-82 of set 8: 80 white rails over a purple cross (map 22 at (5-7, 17), class 11); 81 a white-framed stack of brown, red, blue and white bricks (36 squares, 33 class 10: map 17 at x 13-17, y 20-27 and map 20 at x 20-30, y 1-9); 82 white stripes around blue and red checks (map 20: 13, same area).

Tiles 83-85 of set 8: 83 bare brown branches over red specks, like a dead tree (map 16: 9, map 22: 12), and 84 a grey and white boulder marked red (map 16: 8, map 22: 18), scattered over the red ground; 85 brown and white stripes over red specks, the floor of map 18's room at x 17-30, y 1-4 (54 squares, class 2).

Tiles 86-91 of set 8: 86 another corner of the light blue, grey and white band (map 17 at (14, 15)), 88 the band upright (map 17: 32, map 23 at (19, 13-16); set 7's 25) and 91 the band across (map 17: 51, map 20: 2): the outlines of map 17's quarters; 87 blue stripes across black, the floor of those quarters (503 squares); 89 dark grey blocks, walls on maps 16, 18 and 22 (94 squares); 90 solid white, unused by the maps.

Tiles 92-95 of set 8, solid fills: 92 blue (179 squares), 93 orange (173), 94 purple (169) and 95 green (175), the four-coloured checkerboard that covers map 23 around its checked rooms (about 60 % class 0, the rest class 11).

Colour bytes of tiles 0-9 in set 8 (high nibble: pixel pairs 01, low nibble: pairs 10): the shared figures 0-8 ($26, $CF, $28, $57, $39/$36, $B7/$BC, $98, $59, $76) and tile 9's $46, $46, $E6, $E6, the same bytes as in sets 1-5 and 7.

Colour bytes of tiles 10-29 in set 8: $CB (grey, dark grey) for the sunken square's sides 10, 11, 14 and for 27 and 28; $29 (red, brown) for the hole 12; $E6 for the panels 13; $86 and $89 (orange with blue or brown) for the orange blocks 15-21; $26 for the chain walls 22-23, the ring 26 and the scraps 29; $2B (red, dark grey) for the chevron floor 24-25.

Colour bytes of tiles 30-50 in set 8: $CB with a $2B cell for 30; $46 (purple, blue) for 31; $CB for 32; $EB (light blue, dark grey) for 33 and 35; $C6 for 34; $96 with a $26 cell for the chair 36; $72 (yellow, red) for 37; $E6 for 38 and the door 40; $9B for 39; $96 with a $99 cell for the stripes 41; $47 over $49 for the counter figure 42; $26 for 43, 44, 47 and 49; $76 then three $26 for the ladder 46; $56, $74, $89, $89 for the table 45; $56 for the dots 48; $26 over $2B for 50.

Colour bytes of tiles 51-74 in set 8: $24 (red, purple) for the lattice 51; $26 then $2B for 52; $E6 for 53, 57, 60, 62, 70, 71; $CB for 54; $CB, $CB, $2B, $C6 for 55 and $CB with a $2B cell for 56; $E9 over $E4 for 58; $E4 for 59; $26, $26, $98, $28 for the column 61; $26 for the red ground 63-68, the frame 69, the speckles 72, the blue band 73 and the panels 74.

Colour bytes of tiles 75-95 in set 8: $26 for the checks 75, the white 90 and the blue 92; $86 over $25 for the bars 76; $C6 for 77; $2B with a $CB cell for 78 and $2B for 79; $C4 over $24 (grey, purple) for 80; $98 over $26 for 81; $26 for 82; $29 for the trees 83; $C2, $22, $CB, $CB for the boulder 84; $92 for 85; $E6 for 86 and 91; $26, $26, $56, $C6 for 87; $E6 and $C6 for 88; $B6 for 89; $82 and $86 for the orange 93, $24 with an $84 cell for the purple 94, $56 for the green 95.
